title: SMALL THREE
overview: Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame — the Small 3 — load up an odd disc from their teacher. When they're not looking, Pyontaro's little sister Futaba vanishes.

title: MULTIVERSE
overview: Stranded in a new world, the Small 3 realize they have incredible powers. They meet other versions of themselves and learn how this reality differs.

title: ALIENS
overview: Futaba's abductors subject her to tests, but she just wants her big bwudder. The Small 3 continue the search for Futaba and encounter a tense standoff.

title: MR. SEGAMI
overview: As college student Segami struggles with his dystopian world, a hot schoolmate hands him an enticing flyer. Hoping to meet girls, he finds something else.

title: REBELLION
overview: With his mind in a whirl, Segami runs into the Small 3. They witness a bold fighter pilot pit his life against an alien ship. Will it light a fire?

title: GAME ON
overview: The Rebellion announces a guerrilla attack in Shibuya and Segami resolves to join. Meanwhile, a distraught Futaba stumbles upon a furry winged creature.

title: COUNTERATTACK
overview: Aliens surround a sleeping Futaba! In Shibuya, Segami and his comrades fight fiercely but lose ground. As he retreats, he spots Tashiro under attack.

title: THE STRANGERS
overview: Futaba faces off against a squad of alien soldiers to protect her new friend. Facing heavy losses, Segami and the Rebellion turn to their secret weapon.

title: THE STRONG MEN
overview: Genius commandeers an alien walker and leads a counterattack. But two fearsome alien soldiers are en route. Meanwhile, Doc and the others seek answers.
